title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
description: Authorities say there is no threat and have advised the public to stay calm and follow official channels for information.

title: Five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
description: Hampshire Police believes an unknown group gained entry to the party at an address in Chandler's Ford.

title: 'Like a missile coming down' - Nine killed in fiery Florida jet crash
description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash, which happened near President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort, as a "horrific tragedy".

title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
description: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.

title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
description: The move by Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, was called a "despicable betrayal" by one top Democrat.

title: Democrats have high hopes for midterms, but polls have let them down before
description: Polls have been predicting a Democratic surge, but last-minute deciders and sampling issues mean there's no guarantee.

title: Antonelli becomes world champion as Verstappen wins in Mexico
description: Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history as Max Verstappen wins the Mexico City Grand Prix.

title: A&E warning system to flag sick children deteriorating quickly
description: The initiative, in England, will help busy staff identify children who are deteriorating quickly as they wait for emergency care.

title: King to address slavery in Antigua as PM says he is open to possible UK apology
description: King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour.
